scope: Read-only closure audit of the remaining location UI case; physical iPad pairing takes priority
classification: Observed system reverse-geocoding dependency failure; no implementation or assertion defect identified as the cause of these two failures. This does not prove a global service outage.

failureEvidence.error: GEOErrorDomain -8: Received no results status from server
NSURLErrorDomain -1001: request timed out at system regional dispatcher

proven: Unit tests: fresh and demo instances do not construct a location manager or request weather/location before an explicit choice.
Unit tests: passive refresh cannot request system permission; the explicit Use current location operation can. Already-authorized legacy following does not request broader permission.
Real simulator UI: passive display raised no location alert during the check; explicit Use current location raised Allow While Using App and the test selected it.
Observed failed geocode UI displayed location unavailable. Unit tests preserve an existing manual city and do not invent Philadelphia for a new or explicitly cleared configuration.
Complete-run manual New York selection/search, real Open-Meteo reading, unit preference persistence and explicit clear/relaunch all passed.
notProven: Current-version end-to-end automatic city resolution followed by live weather: the current-city expectation failed, so its later live-reading assertion was not reached.
Physical iPad location permissions, GPS/city accuracy, regional dispatcher reliability and denial/revocation/background recovery on hardware.
Actual late geocoder callbacks after stop: generation and identity guards were reviewed in code; the cited manager-stub tests are not a physical callback test.
decision: Keep testLocationPermissionUsesDetectedCity failed with strict city/live-reading assertions. Do not rerun an unchanged external failure merely to obtain green, and do not interrupt physical pairing. Manual city selection remains the tested alternative.
